translations.web: I said in my heart, “God will judge the righteous and the wicked; for there is a time there for every purpose and for every work.”
translations.bsb: I said in my heart, “God will judge the righteous and the wicked, since there is a time for every activity and every deed.”
translations.kjv: I said in mine heart, God shall judge the righteous and the wicked: for there is a time there for every purpose and for every work.
translations.asv: I said in my heart, God will judge the righteous and the wicked; for there is a time there for every purpose and for every work.
